definition.definition: The Office of the Economic Adviser's Producer Price Index measures the change in prices received by domestic producers for their output, indexed to 2022-23 = 100. Unlike the Wholesale Price Index, which counts wholesale transactions including imports, OPPI tracks producer output prices by product group. The all-commodities index is published monthly; the year-on-year rate shown here is computed from those published levels and labelled as computed.
definition.source_name: Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Office of the Economic Adviser — OPPI (via MoSPI e-Sankhyiki)
definition.term: Producer Price Index (OPPI), all commodities — base 2022-23

indicator.label: Producer price inflation, y-o-y
indicator.scoring_rule: Computed from the published all-commodities OPPI index: green 2-6%, watch 0-2% / >6%, red <0%.
indicator.source: MoSPI OPPI monthly (computed from published levels)

cross_checks.note: The published figure is quoted on the headline; the index-derived series is the long history drawn on the chart. The index is published rounded to one decimal, so a computed y-o-y carries a quantisation of about +/-0.05pp.
